content.json:
## Defender CSPM ダッシュボード
Defender CSPM のセキュリティ態勢の要点を 1 画面で表示します。詳細な分析は「Defender CSPM ダッシュボード」ブック版を使ってください。

parameters.name: Subscriptions
parameters.label: サブスクリプション
parameters.query:
resourcecontainers
| where type =~ "microsoft.resources/subscriptions"
| project value = id, label = name, selected = true
| order by label asc

parameters.name: Environment
parameters.label: 環境 (Azure / AWS / GCP など)
parameters.query:
securityresources
| where type == "microsoft.security/assessments"
| extend env = tostring(properties.resourceDetails.Source)
| where isnotempty(env)
| distinct env
| order by env asc
| project value = env, label = env

content.query:
securityresources
| where type == "microsoft.security/securescores"
| where name =~ "ascScore"
| summarize value = round(avg(todouble(properties.score.percentage)) * 100, 1), subs = dcount(subscriptionId)
| extend title = "平均セキュア スコア (%)", subtitle = strcat(subs, " サブスクリプションの平均")
content.noDataMessage: 該当するデータがありません。

content.query:
securityresources
| where type == "microsoft.security/assessments"
| extend env = tostring(properties.resourceDetails.Source)
| where "*" in ({Environment}) or env in ({Environment})
| extend status = tostring(properties.status.code)
| extend severity = tostring(properties.metadata.severity)
| extend riskLevel = tostring(properties.risk.level)
| extend recName = tostring(properties.displayName)
| extend resId = coalesce(tostring(properties.resourceDetails.Id), tostring(properties.resourceDetails.id), extract(@"(?i)^(.*)/providers/microsoft.security/assessments/", 1, id))
| where status == "Unhealthy"
| summarize value = dcount(name)
| extend title = "未対応の推奨事項", subtitle = "種類の数"
content.noDataMessage: 該当するデータがありません。

content.query:

| where name =~ "ascScore"
| extend scorePct = round(todouble(properties.score.percentage) * 100, 1)
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers | where type =~ "microsoft.resources/subscriptions" | project subscriptionId, subscriptionName = name) on subscriptionId

content.query:
securityresources
| where type == "microsoft.security/assessments"
| extend env = tostring(properties.resourceDetails.Source)
| where "*" in ({Environment}) or env in ({Environment})
| extend status = tostring(properties.status.code)
| extend severity = tostring(properties.metadata.severity)
| extend riskLevel = tostring(properties.risk.level)
| extend recName = tostring(properties.displayName)
| extend resId = coalesce(tostring(properties.resourceDetails.Id), tostring(properties.resourceDetails.id), extract(@"(?i)^(.*)/providers/microsoft.security/assessments/", 1, id))

content.query:
securityresources
| where type == "microsoft.security/assessments/subassessments"
| where tostring(properties.status.code) == "Unhealthy"
| extend severity = tostring(properties.status.severity)
| extend resId = coalesce(tostring(properties.resourceDetails.id), tostring(properties.resourceDetails.Id), extract(@"(?i)^(.*)/providers/microsoft.security/assessments/", 1, id))

content.query:
securityresources
| where type == "microsoft.security/regulatorycompliancestandards"
| extend passed = tolong(properties.passedControls), failed = tolong(properties.failedControls)
| summarize passed = sum(passed), failed = sum(failed) by standard = name
| extend pct = iff(passed + failed > 0, round(todouble(passed) / todouble(passed + failed) * 100, 1), 0.0)
| project standard, pct, failed
| order by pct asc
content.title: 規制コンプライアンス（標準ごとの合格率）
content.noDataMessage: 該当するデータがありません。

content.query:
securityresources
| where type == "microsoft.security/assessments/governanceassignments"
| extend assessmentId = tolower(extract(@"(?i)^(.*)/governanceassignments/[^/]+$", 1, id)), dueDate = todatetime(properties.remediationDueDate)
| join kind=leftouter (securityresources | where type == "microsoft.security/assessments" | project assessmentId = tolower(id), status = tostring(properties.status.code)) on assessmentId
| extend govStatus = case(status == "Healthy", "完了", isnull(dueDate), "期限なし", dueDate < now(), "期限超過", "期限内")
| summarize count() by govStatus
content.title: ガバナンス（対応状況）
content.noDataMessage: ガバナンス ルールの割り当てはありません。

content.query:
securityresources
| where type == "microsoft.security/pricings"
| where name =~ "CloudPosture"
| extend state = iff(tostring(properties.pricingTier) =~ "Standard", "Defender CSPM（有償）", "Foundational CSPM のみ")
| summarize count() by state
content.title: Defender CSPM の有効化状況（サブスクリプション数）
